regions.sentence: California: splicing raw VIIRS onto MODIS shows 9.0x the hotspots per year in 2019-2025 compared with 2001-2017; MODIS itself shows 2.05x. The naive splice overstates post-2018 activity by a factor of 4.4; the harmonized series shows 2.06x.

Greece: splicing raw VIIRS onto MODIS shows 2.94x the hotspots per year in 2019-2025 compared with 2001-2017; MODIS itself shows 0.83x. The naive splice overstates post-2018 activity by a factor of 3.56; the harmonized series shows 0.84x.
